verdict.rationale: YYLO supports defining a task's intent/contract (init --task, YAML contract export) and has a read-only preflight stage before an agent's changes are committed, plus protected-SHA worktree isolation before merge — but there is no documented explicit approval/sign-off step where an engineering-lead reviews and approves scope before the agent is permitted to touch the repo. missing for 10: an explicit approval/gate command or workflow state requiring lead sign-off, role-based approval permissions, and evidence of a real review UI/step rather than just read-only preflight.
